A1.justification: Both PDFs describe UniAP and provide readable main text, equations, figures, tables and appendices. Corresponding material can be matched reliably despite appendix renumbering and layout changes.

before.justification: v5 reports original throughput, strategy optimization time, scalability and ablation experiments in Section 4, plus cost-model accuracy and MFU measurements in Appendices E–F.

after.justification: v6 retains these original experimental results in Section 4 and the corresponding cost-model accuracy and MFU measurements in Appendices F–G.

M1.justification: The profiling procedure, cost models, MIQP/QIP formulations and Unified Optimization Process in Algorithm 1 are retained. The added explanations do not introduce a different optimization procedure or method component.

E1.justification: Both versions use English Wikipedia and ImageNet-1K, the same BERT, T5, ViT, Swin and Llama workloads, and environments ENVA–ENVD. Heterogeneous clusters are mentioned only as future work in v6.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Galvatron and Alpa; Table 2 retains Megatron and DeepSpeed (ZeRO-3), including the same unavailable or unsuccessful cases. The appendix accuracy and MFU comparisons also retain their comparators.

E3.justification: Batch sizes, model configurations, precision, hardware scales, throughput averaging over iterations 10–60, and solver limits and early stopping are unchanged. The experiment details move from Appendix D to Appendix E without a reported protocol revision.

E4.justification: The strategy-space ablation in Figure 6, Megatron candidate analysis in Table 3, scalability studies, cost-model accuracy analysis and BERT-Huge case study are retained. Renumbered appendices contain the same analyses.

E5.justification: The uncertainty reporting in Tables 1, 2 and 4 is unchanged. v6 adds no run or seed counts, uncertainty estimation procedures, confidence intervals or statistical tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4, empirical plots and appendix MFU values match. For example, Table 1 retains ENVC throughput of 4.63 samples/s for UniAP versus 1.22 for Galvatron, and the appendix retains average estimation errors of 3.59% versus 11.17%.

T1.justification: The equations, contiguity proof and complexity analysis retain their mathematical substance. The new main-text explanation of Z repeats v5 Appendix A; Theorem A.1 becomes B.1 with only node-set wording clarified, and the notation table summarizes existing definitions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the joint optimization contribution and first-method claim. The headline gains remain up to 3.80 times in throughput and 107 times in strategy optimization speed.

C2.justification: New Appendix H explicitly states that UniAP is designed and tested on homogeneous clusters and leaves mixed NVIDIA GPU/DCU clusters for future work. Section 4.1 also identifies exploration of alternative solvers as future work.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 newly identifies ENVD's previously generic DCUs as Hygon DCUs, adding hardware specificity without establishing a hardware change. The Gurobi choice is relocated, while its detailed configuration and the training and software details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2.1 adds direct citations for PP, DP, TP and FSDP using works already in the bibliography. This is a limited attribution addition; all 47 referenced works and the substantive positioning against earlier parallelism methods are retained.

P1.justification: v6 shortens the opening introduction, explains Z in the main text, relocates the solver discussion and adds acknowledgements, a notation section and a limitations section. Most prose and the overall narrative sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is redrawn with colored layer blocks and a revised caption, omitting the earlier MP panel. v6 adds notation Table 5, renumbers the existing model table as Table 6, and adjusts caption placement, hyperlink styling and appendix figure placement. Empirical graphics are retained.

improvement.justification: The notation summary and main-text explanation of Z make the formulation easier to follow, while Appendix H explicitly states the homogeneous-cluster scope. These provide limited improvements in clarity and qualification; the method, proofs and empirical evidence remain materially unchanged.
